articles.title: Donald Trump Jr. exits advisory role at prediction market Kalshi
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Donald Trump Jr. is no longer a paid adviser for Kalshi, the prediction market company said Thursday.

articles.title: U of T rejects report saying school over-polices, under-protects Muslims, Arabs, Palestinians
articles.summary: The University of Toronto says it will not accept recommendations from a review that found the school has a "general pattern of over-policing and under-protecting" Muslims, Arabs and Palestinians.

articles.title: Friend of woman stabbed to death in North York left traumatized after witnessing violent murder
articles.summary: A friend and roommate of a woman who was stabbed to death says she not only witnessed the attack, but tried to help as she saw the horrific scene unfold in the parking lot of the North York apartment building they called home. articles.title: Industry minister 'fed up' after meeting with Stellantis, says automaker breached contract
articles.summary: Industry Minister Mélanie Joly says she is "fed up" with automaker Stellantis after meeting with company representatives on Thursday. The company this week announced its intention to sell its Brampton, Ont., plant to an armoured vehicle manufacturer.

articles.title: Meet the 1st woman to run an ultra marathon in Antarctica
articles.summary: Oakville’s Stephanie Case made history after completing a grueling 100-mile race across the frozen continent — pushing through sub-minus-20-degree temperatures, frozen gear, and more than 17 hours of continuous running.

articles.title: U of T rejects report, recommendations on anti-Muslim, anti-Arab discrimination
articles.summary: A review of the University of Toronto’s (U of T) policies and practices has found the school has a “general pattern of over-policing and under-protecting” Muslims, Arabs and Palestinians, with a report laying out dozens of recommendations related to academic freedom, on-campus security methods, institutional autonomy and other concerns. articles.summary: The holiday season is set to officially arrive in downtown Toronto as CF Toronto Eaton Centre’s 10th Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony returns on Nov. 12, marking a milestone year for one of the city’s most recognizable holiday traditions. articles.title: Coroner's inquest to examine police-involved shooting death of Mississauga man
articles.summary: A coroner's inquest, initially set for Thursday, will begin on Friday to examine the circumstances surrounding the death of a man who was shot in the head by police west of Toronto nearly seven years ago.

articles.title: Carney aware of 'some aspects' of Stellantis auto plant sale, but says company still broke deal
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney says he had been informed of "some aspects" of Stellantis's plan to sell an idled Brampton, Ont., auto plant to Canadian armoured vehicle maker Roshel Inc., before the deal was announced.

articles.title: House fire in Ajax 'appears suspicious': Durham police
articles.summary: A house fire in Ajax on Thursday morning is being looked at as a suspicious incident, according to Durham police.

articles.title: Police ID 1 of 2 suspects after fatal shooting in Rexdale
articles.summary: Suspect Joseph Kunene, 19, of Toronto is considered armed and dangerous, according to a police news release Wednesday.

articles.title: Man given life sentences for 2024 double murder in Oshawa
articles.summary: Mark Gordon was sentenced to two life sentences without the possibility of parole for 21 years in the shooting deaths of Patrick Montgomery, 42, and Andrieana Montgomery, 42.

articles.title: Lawyer sues Durham police for $7.1M over alleged violent arrest at Oshawa courthouse
articles.summary: A criminal defence lawyer who alleges she was violently assaulted by Durham Regional Police officers inside an Oshawa courthouse has filed a $7.1-million lawsuit against the regional police service board and five officers.

articles.title: 2 Mississauga men charged for stealing 9 coffee machines valued at nearly $86K: police
articles.summary: Two Mississauga men have been arrested and charged after allegedly stealing nine commercial coffee machines valued at nearly $86,000, Peel police say. Six of the machines have been recovered.

articles.title: Stellantis auto plant sale draws optimism, hurt in Brampton, Ont., after 2,000 jobs lost
articles.summary: Workers and local politicians are expressing disappointment at Stellantis's decision to sell its Brampton, Ont., plant to armoured vehicle maker Roshel Inc., but some local businesses and experts say the new company could bring more jobs and foot traffic to the community.
